items.docs:
With the engageSPARK Airtime top-up API, you can send prepaid airtime to anyone on the fly. In some countries, airtime is known as prepaid phone credit, mobile credit, or load top-up.

We are able to send very specific amounts of airtime per mobile network operator in each country.  For example, we cannot send 25 Philippine pesos of airtime to a mobile phone on the Smart mobile network in the Philippines, but we can send 25 pesos to a mobile phone on the Globe mobile network.
